verdict.rationale: LocalAI's getting-started docs show a first-party CLI command that pulls a GGUF model straight from a Hugging Face URI and runs it, so the core story is directly supported. The only evidence, though, is a single command example with no explanation of supported repos, formats, file selection or authentication. Missing for 10: documentation of the huggingface:// scheme's scope (formats beyond GGUF, gated/private repos, quantization selection), and independent or hands-on corroboration that HF downloads work as shown.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can download and run open models directly from Hugging Face
